name: Stored difference stays inside the shrink corridor
criteria: Across generated mornings from at least five people, the stored difference never exceeds the raw difference in size.
The stored difference never flips the sign of the raw difference.
The corridor holds at every generated count, spread and difference.
acceptance: Twenty isolated runLearningFitOnce executions generate 10-40 mornings, 5-9 reporters, raw magnitudes 0.05-1.2 m, and spreads 0-0.3 m. The acceptance computes raw difference from its own written mornings, checks stored magnitude/sign, and rejects controlled sign-flip and magnitude-expansion mutations.
